kinds.name: PreFileCreate
kinds.doc: Fires before a new file is written.

kinds.name: PreFileUpdate
kinds.doc: Fires before an existing file is changed.

kinds.name: PreFileDelete
kinds.doc: Fires before a file is deleted.

kinds.name: PreCommandInvoke
kinds.doc: Fires before a command is invoked.

kinds.name: PreToolUse
kinds.doc: Fires before any tool runs — the general refusable moment.

kinds.name: PostFileCreate
kinds.doc: Fires after a file is created.

kinds.name: PostFileUpdate
kinds.doc: Fires after a file is changed.

kinds.name: PostFileDelete
kinds.doc: Fires after a file is deleted.

kinds.name: PostTagWrite
kinds.doc: Fires when a tag is written in the trajectory, as the turn settles.

kinds.name: Stop
kinds.doc: Fires at the end of a turn — a gate's usual moment.

aliases.name: PreFileWrite
aliases.doc: Expands to PreFileCreate + PreFileUpdate. Admitted on both a gate and a context (both may wake pre-write).

aliases.name: PostFileWrite
aliases.doc: Expands to PostFileCreate + PostFileUpdate. Admitted on a CONTEXT only — a gate does not wake on settled content, so `PostFileWrite` is not a gate alias.
